description: This is a false-colour satellite image depicting the estuary of the Guadalquivir River in Southern Spain. The surrounding land areas appear in shades of red and pink, indicating vegetated surfaces in this spectral band, while areas of lighter grey might represent urban or bare ground. The main body of water to the left is deep blue, transitioning to lighter turquoise and cyan within the river channel, suggesting varying depths or sediment load. A specific portion of the river, corresponding to the estuary, is highlighted by a thin blue outline and filled with a translucent light blue overlay. The image is credited to E. Mazón. This image serves as an example of a CORINE Land Cover (CLC) 522 Estuaries classification.
